import csv
tsid='0361d2c1-48db-57ae-b48b-913d1c1cef38'
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    rows=[x for x in csv.DictReader(f) if x['timeseries_id']==tsid]
day=[x for x in rows if x['timestamp'].startswith('2018-04-10')]
# Interpretation: strictly after 18:00 (h>18) + before 08:00 (h<8)
strict=sum(1 for x in day if (int(x['timestamp'][11:13])<8 or int(x['timestamp'][11:13])>18) and float(x['value'])>0)
# Interpretation incl 18:00 (h>=18)
incl=sum(1 for x in day if (int(x['timestamp'][11:13])<8 or int(x['timestamp'][11:13])>=18) and float(x['value'])>0)
print('strict (before 08, after 18 exclusive):',strict,' incl 18:00:',incl)
